says: next/: PR 1012's two shared suites, `CodeStoreTest.suite` (runtime/CodeStoreTest.ts) and `ReloadTest.suite` (runtime/ReloadTest.ts), each run only on a real SQLite file, in node/CodeStore.integration.test.ts and node/Reload.integration.test.ts, so after 0536 the merge line runs none of their laws. 0536 asks for a second run of each on an in-memory layer.
proof: `rg -ln "CodeStoreTest\.|ReloadTest\." next/` on a4add0978 lists only those two integration files and CodeStoreTest.ts itself. Both open a `DatabaseSync` on a file in a temp folder and reopen the same file, so they were renamed to `*.integration.test.ts` when PR 1012 was brought up to date with main.
cost: A change that breaks the code store's or the reload's laws in the shared rules, not in SQLite, is found up to 3 hours after it merges, on the schedule, not on its pull request. A run of each suite over an in-memory store (as 0535 gave git) would bring them back to the merge line.
